# Packaged OCR runtime

Generated by `npm run build` from package-lock.json. Runtime assets are committed so
loading the unpacked extension requires no npm install or download. Do not hand-edit
vendor files. `npm run check` verifies assets.json byte counts and SHA-256 hashes.

- Tesseract.js 6.0.1, Apache-2.0: runtime ESM and worker distributions.
- tesseract.js-core 6.1.2, Apache-2.0: LSTM-only SIMD and non-SIMD `.wasm.js` files.
  These exact distributions embed the WASM binary in base64; separate `.wasm` files
  are not requested by them. OEM=1 and legacyCore=false select only these two variants.
- @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0: `4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz` (2,952,873 bytes).
  npm metadata declares MIT for the package; the upstream naptha/tessdata repository
  licenses trained data under Apache-2.0. Its complete upstream license is included.

Complete license texts/notices are in licenses/. Buffer and ieee754 are bundled into
the upstream worker; their notices and complete licenses are retained. Tesseract core
also includes its upstream generated-code notices. Sources:

- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/tree/v6.0.1
- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- https://github.com/naptha/tessdata/blob/gh-pages/LICENSE
- https://github.com/feross/buffer/blob/master/LICENSE
- https://github.com/feross/ieee754/blob/master/LICENSE

The unmodified upstream bundles contain dormant CDN defaults. Application configuration
overrides all three paths with extension-local URLs and uses workerBlobURL=false,
cacheMethod=none. CSP permits self connections/scripts/workers and data: connections for embedded WASM bytes. No runtime CDN,
model download, telemetry or analytics. Source maps and legacy OCR cores are omitted.
